target: Spoiler-free total completion of every campaign rank and collectible, all records, skills, titles, extra modes, PC crossover content, persistent RE.NET entries, and hidden interactions

areas.name: Route and Profile Setup
areas.location_cue: Steam's DLC manager, the main menu, and the online-options screen.
areas.note: The chosen route is Windows PC with every mode DLC and the PC-only crossover installed.

levels.1: Start by making every permanent mode available from one installation.
levels.2: Install Resident Evil 6 and all four Extra Content mode packages through Steam.
levels.3: Open Steam's DLC panel, enable Survivors, Predator, Onslaught, and Siege, finish all updates, then launch once and confirm each appears under Extra Content.

levels.1: One branch of No Mercy belongs only to the Windows route.
levels.2: Confirm the Left 4 Dead 2 character set appears in Mercenaries No Mercy.
levels.3: Start No Mercy on PC, open character selection, and verify Coach, Ellis, Nick, and Rochelle are selectable; the crossover does not exist in the original console releases.

levels.1: Several persistent rewards live outside the local menus.
levels.2: Connect the PC save to RESIDENT EVIL.NET and enable automatic data upload.
levels.3: Sign in on Capcom's portal, link the Steam game data, enable Auto Data Upload in the game options, complete one short run, and wait until the portal reflects the new record.

levels.1: A clean copy makes long record and unlock grinds recoverable.
levels.2: Close the game and back up the untouched local profile before beginning the campaigns.
levels.3: Exit fully before copying the save with your normal backup method, restore-test that copy separately, then retain dated snapshots after each campaign and major online unlock batch.

levels.1: There is no owned gameplay footage for this game yet.
levels.2: This pack intentionally contains no screenshots, maps, or generated sketches.
levels.3: Use the physical cues in the text. Add optional visuals only after Sami's own recording can provide a provenance-tracked frame for the exact item.

areas.name: Campaign Records and Titles
areas.location_cue: The Medals tab under Records and the Titles page under Dog Tags.
areas.note: Numbered labels conceal story-specific record names while preserving every mechanical requirement.

levels.1: The Records menu tracks a distinct campaign or combat condition.
levels.2: Complete the corresponding concealed campaign milestone.
levels.3: Clear every campaign chapter on at least Amateur and let each result screen save. These numbered milestones unlock automatically during that sweep; their original names remain hidden because they describe narrative events.

levels.3: Repeat 'perform precisely timed action inputs' until Dog Tags shows the full ladder (10, 30, 100); the final required target is 200. If later star fields are blank, the title ends at its last displayed tier.

areas.name: Agent Hunt
areas.location_cue: The Agent Hunt tile under Extra Content and its creature-skill screen.
areas.note: Creature identities that could disclose later encounters remain hidden behind numbered medal entries.

levels.1: Learn both movement and attack recovery before chasing rare forms.
levels.2: Enter another player's compatible campaign as a creature and finish the session.
levels.3: Choose Agent Hunt, accept a compatible session, play the assigned creature until the host clears or is defeated, and remain through results so the mode record and first medals register.

levels.3: Read the active event's date window and scoring rule on RE.NET, upload qualifying PC data before its deadline, then claim every participation reward. Historical placements cannot be recreated; only current and future rotations are honestly attainable.

areas.name: Secret Interactions
areas.location_cue: Optional scenery marked by a magnifying-glass prompt, playground equipment, instruments, or loose props.
areas.note: These interactions award no completion record but are included because they are deliberate hidden content.

levels.1: Optional interaction prompts reward close inspection of ordinary scenery.
levels.2: In Chris or Leon Chapter 4, look for a detached hand near the microwave.
levels.3: Reach Chris or Leon Chapter 4 and damage a hand-bearing enemy until one hand separates. Do not destroy it: let it leap toward you, or pick it up while standing beside the microwave. The contextual action places it inside and triggers the hidden animation.
